headline: Singapore Q3 Retrenchments Edge Up While Overall Employment Growth Accelerates
summary: Retrenchments in Singapore increased slightly in the third quarter of 2026, even as total employment expanded faster than the previous quarter across both resident and non-resident workforces.
why: Singapore serves as a bellwether for Southeast Asian trade and regional corporate headquarters activity, with labor data signaling shifts in business sentiment.

impacts.name: Singapore
impacts.why: Strong net hiring indicates macroeconomic resilience despite isolated corporate restructuring and layoffs.
